Charity #BN 884271180RR0001     -     Non-profit Corporation  #212564

SCAT Street Cat Rescue Program Inc. is a volunteer-driven animal welfare agency which has been saving and bettering feline lives since 1996.

This agency’s primary focus is on feral and homeless cats living on the streets of Saskatoon, Saskatchewan, Canada.  Our goal is to provide a healthier future for each cat brought into the program.

To accomplish this goal, we have built a network of hundreds of volunteers and supporters - everything from colony care givers to foster homes and acreage relocations, and from office management to fundraising event coordinators.  Street Cat promotes a high standard of animal health care thanks to our network of animal health professionals. 

The SCAT Adoption Centre helps approximately 300 cats a year and receives approximately 2000 hotline calls yearly from members of the community requesting help for cats.
